tasks.title: Setup Project Repository with Poetry
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with Poetry for dependency management and create the basic project structure.
tasks.details:
1. Create a new GitHub repository
2. Initialize Poetry with `poetry init`
3. Set up the following directory structure:
   - `/src` - Main source code
   - `/examples` - Example applications
   - `/docs` - Documentation
   - `/tests` - Unit and integration tests
4. Create a README.md with project overview
5. Add essential dependencies to pyproject.toml:
   ```toml
   [tool.poetry.dependencies]
   python = "^3.9"
   langchain = "^0.0.267"
   streamlit = "^1.26.0"
   faiss-cpu = "^1.7.4"
   chromadb = "^0.4.13"
   openai = "^0.28.0"
   anthropic = "^0.3.11"
   ```
6. Create a .gitignore file with Python standard ignores
7. Set up a virtual environment with `poetry install`
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that Poetry correctly initializes the project and installs all dependencies. Check that the directory structure is created correctly and the virtual environment works properly.

tasks.title: Implement Utility Functions and Helper Libraries
tasks.description: Create reusable utility functions and helper libraries that will be used across the project.
tasks.details:
Create a utilities module with the following components:

1. Create `src/utils/llm_utils.py` with functions for:
   - LLM provider selection and configuration
   - API key management
   - Rate limiting and error handling

2. Create `src/utils/embedding_utils.py` with functions for:
   - Text preprocessing for embeddings
   - Batch processing for large datasets
   - Embedding caching mechanisms

3. Create `src/utils/document_utils.py` with functions for:
   - Document loading from various formats (PDF, TXT, DOCX)
   - Text chunking strategies (fixed size, semantic, etc.)
   - Metadata extraction and management

4. Create `src/utils/evaluation_utils.py` with metrics for:
   - RAG pipeline evaluation
   - Response quality assessment
   - Retrieval precision/recall metrics

Implement comprehensive error handling and logging throughout all utility functions.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for each utility function to verify correct behavior. Test with various inputs including edge cases. Verify error handling works as expected. Create integration tests that use multiple utility functions together.

tasks.details:

tasks.title: Implement Basic RAG Pipeline
tasks.description: Create a basic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline for text documents.
tasks.details:
Implement a basic RAG pipeline in the `examples/rag_basic` directory:

1. Create `document_processor.py` for:
   - Loading documents from files (PDF, TXT, DOCX)
   - Text extraction and cleaning
   - Chunking strategies implementation
   - Metadata extraction

2. Create `retriever.py` for:
   - Vector store setup (using FAISS or Chroma)
   - Similarity search implementation
   - Top-k retrieval with configurable parameters
   - Metadata filtering options

3. Create `generator.py` for:
   - Context formatting for LLM
   - Prompt template creation
   - Response generation with LangChain
   - Source attribution

4. Create `rag_pipeline.py` to integrate all components:
   - End-to-end pipeline implementation
   - Configuration options
   - Simple API for usage
   - Example usage with sample documents

Use the utility functions from previous tasks. Implement proper error handling for each stage of the pipeline.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the pipeline with various document types and queries. Verify retrieval quality with different chunking strategies. Test with different LLMs to ensure compatibility. Measure end-to-end performance and optimize bottlenecks. Create a test suite with expected question-answer pairs.

tasks.title: Implement Advanced RAG Techniques

tasks.details:

1. Create `hybrid_retrieval.py` demonstrating:

2. Create `reranking.py` demonstrating:

   - Relevance scoring algorithms
   - Integration with retrieval pipeline

3. Create `query_transformation.py` demonstrating:
   - Query expansion techniques
   - Query decomposition for complex questions
   - Hypothetical document embeddings
   - Query routing to different retrievers

4. Create `context_augmentation.py` demonstrating:
   - Dynamic context window management
   - Context relevance filtering
   - Context ordering strategies
   - Handling context overflow

Implement comprehensive logging to track the performance of each technique. Create configuration options to enable/disable different features.
tasks.testStrategy: Compare retrieval quality metrics (precision, recall, MRR) between basic and advanced techniques. Create benchmark datasets with ground truth relevance. Test with complex, multi-hop queries. Measure the impact of each technique on response quality and performance.

tasks.title: Implement RAG Evaluation Framework
tasks.description: Create a framework for evaluating and fine-tuning RAG systems.
tasks.details:
Implement a RAG evaluation framework in the `examples/rag_evaluation` directory:

1. Create `retrieval_metrics.py` for:
   - Precision, recall, and F1 calculation
   - Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) implementation
   - nDCG and other ranking metrics
   - Retrieval latency measurement

2. Create `generation_metrics.py` for:
   - Answer relevance evaluation
   - Factual consistency checking
   - Hallucination detection
   - Response completeness assessment

3. Create `evaluation_datasets.py` for:
   - Test dataset creation and management
   - Ground truth annotation tools
   - Dataset splitting and sampling
   - Synthetic test case generation

4. Create `rag_evaluator.py` to integrate all components:
   - End-to-end evaluation pipeline
   - Comparative evaluation of different RAG configurations
   - Visualization of evaluation results
   - Recommendations for improvement

Implement both automatic metrics and tools for human evaluation. Create dashboards for visualizing evaluation results.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate metrics implementation against known benchmarks. Test with diverse query types and document collections. Compare automatic metrics with human judgments. Verify that the evaluation framework can detect common RAG failure modes.

tasks.title: Implement Continuous Integration and Testing
tasks.description: Set up continuous integration and comprehensive testing for the project.
tasks.details:
Implement CI/CD and testing infrastructure:

1. Set up GitHub Actions workflow in `.github/workflows/main.yml`:
   - Run tests on push and pull requests
   - Check code formatting with Black and isort
   - Run linting with flake8 or pylint
   - Generate test coverage reports

2. Create comprehensive tests in the `tests` directory:
   - Unit tests for utility functions
   - Integration tests for components
   - End-to-end tests for pipelines
   - Performance benchmarks

3. Implement test utilities:
   - Test fixtures and factories
   - Mock LLM responses for deterministic testing
   - Test data generation
   - Performance measurement tools

4. Create documentation for testing:
   - Testing strategy document
   - Guide for writing new tests
   - CI/CD pipeline documentation

Use pytest for test implementation. Aim for high test coverage of critical components.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify CI pipeline runs successfully. Check that tests catch regressions when introduced. Measure and maintain test coverage. Ensure tests run in a reasonable time. Validate that mock components accurately represent real behavior.
